Записан как... = saved as. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'писать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to write down; to save (a contact)', paired with 'записывать'.

meanings.note: очередь подходит = one's turn is coming up

Это мне подходит = that suits me. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ходить'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to approach, to come up; to suit', paired with 'подойти'.

examples.trans: Let's go, our turn in the queue is coming up.

examples.text: Я к печке подхожу. А он маячит перед глазами!

Listen, look (to get attention). Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'слушать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to listen (for a while)', paired with 'слушать'.

examples.trans: Listen, this is important.
Let's listen.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look
meanings.note: One completed look. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'смотреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to have a look', paired with 'смотреть'.
Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'смотреть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to have a look', paired with 'смотреть'.

examples.trans: May I have a look?
I only had a look.
Can I go and have a look?

приготовить.gloss: to prepare, to cook, to make

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare
meanings.note: Takes accusative. Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'готовить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to prepare, to cook, to make', paired with 'готовить'.

examples.trans: I made a cake.
Mum cooked a delicious dinner.

examples.text: Я торт приготовила. Ты любишь сладкое?
examples.trans: I made a cake. Do you have a sweet tooth?

meanings.note: Prefix 'раз-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'ослать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to send out to all'.

examples.trans: I want to send it out to the guests before the wedding.

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и разослать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and to send out to all on time.

not to to send out to all (negated infinitive)

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: Adverb of degree. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ильно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
